source_replay: Immutable saved real government source captures from the 51-state/DC public read sample; current copied holdings read first; no new source request or refetch.
bodies_added_definition: New native body records confirmed visible by the actual reader place package after publication.
bodies_updated_definition: Existing native bodies with newly published or changed fact values.
meetings_added_definition: Native meeting entities with a newly published or changed live starts_at fact; actual reader calendar differences are separate columns.
